page.title: Create an organization
page.intro: Create a business organization for your team. You become its first administrator.

helpers.id: The internal identifier. It cannot be changed after creation.
helpers.alias: 3–63 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter or digit. It cannot be changed after creation.
helpers.website: Optional. An absolute http or https address.

validation.aliasShape: Use 3–63 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter or digit.
validation.aliasReserved: That alias is reserved. Choose another one.
validation.displayNameTooLong: Keep the display name to 100 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionTooLong: Keep the description to 500 characters or fewer.
validation.emailShape: Enter one email address, for example team@example.com.
validation.websiteShape: Enter an absolute http or https address with a host, for example https://example.com.
validation.websiteTooLong: Keep the website to 2048 bytes or fewer.
validation.identifierShape: The identifier cannot contain blanks or control characters.

switching.title: Entering your new organization…
switching.failedTitle: The organization was created, but it could not be opened.
switching.failedDescription: The organization exists already. Retry to enter it; creating it again is not needed.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.
errors.badRequest: Something in what you submitted was not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to create an organization.
errors.conflict: That change conflicts with an existing organization.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: You are creating organizations too quickly. Try again later.

client.network: The network is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
client.timeout: That took too long to finish. Please try again later.
client.protocol: The service ran into a problem. Try again in a moment.

authn.session_not_found: Your session no longer exists. Sign in again.
authn.session_revoked: Your session was revoked. Sign in again.
authn.token_expired: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
authn.refresh_token_invalid: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again.
authn.refresh_token_reused: Unusual activity was detected. Sign in again.
authn.contact_required: Verify your email address before creating an organization.
authn.forbidden: This account cannot create an organization right now. Sign in as yourself and make sure you are not impersonating another account.
authn.bad_request: Something in what you submitted was not valid. Check the form and try again.

org.organization_limit: Your account has reached the maximum number of active business organizations and cannot create another.
org.rate_limited: You are creating organizations too quickly. Try again later.
org.rate_limited_wait: Too many organization creations. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
org.rate_limited_wait_long: Too many organization creations. Try again in about {{minutes}} minutes.
